name: Sacrifice ~Seifuku Gari~
source:
Era of crisis. There is a school that helps fired girls to gain new skills. Main character becomes director of this school so that he can insult any girls transferred here.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
危机时代。有一所学校帮助被解雇的女孩们学习新技能。主人公成为了这所学校的校长，以便凌辱每一个转学来的女孩。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
